prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit / style-transfer.
Asset: one existing installed Feudal Lord Simulator game image; non-destructive Wave41 revision.
Input1 is the immutable geometry reference. Edit this image, do not design a different asset.
Unify oak hurdle posts and slats with the project gate/corner reference: visible restrained grain, warm brown midtones, worn ends. Preserve all rail geometry and connections.
ART_BIBLE_v2: soft hand-painted prerender, muted southern English1300-1450 material palette, upper-left world lighting, no black cartoon outline, no added text/watermark.
Maintain EXACT original canvas aspect 128:96, original transparent padding, anchor/pivot, ground contact, silhouette, perspective and occupied bounds. Do not crop, recenter or rotate. Output exactly one image; no comparison sheet.
Genuine transparent background. All originally empty regions remain transparent.
Input2 and Input3 provide wood grain/brushwork ONLY. Keep Input1's number of posts, all rail endpoints, joints, EXACT silhouette and image placement unchanged. Subtle irregular weathered oak grain only, no new gate hardware. Full canvas same 4:3 aspect ratio. Keep the flat squared cut timber cross-sections; do not round into logs.

inspection.geometry: Original center joint and source high-gradient structural boundaries retained exactly. Grain only in face interiors.
inspection.visual_observation: Source center-post no longer a separate bright upright; source rail-junction positions and broad shading restored. Subtle generated wood grain survives only inside safe opaque face regions. Bright/dark proof and native128x96 opened.

processing.method: generated alpha bbox registered by affine crop+single Lanczos resize into original alpha bbox; original alpha reapplied pixel-exact; generated RGB extended up to 8px into uncovered original edge. No original geometry rescale. Explicit registration and pre-alpha proof retained.

post_review_revision.reason: Restore original center-post and rail junction geometry; strong generated center-post face read as separate upright.
post_review_revision.method: Original RGB/alpha restored as structural base. Exact source junction ROI x51..77,y24..69 retained. Generated wood luminance grain extracted minus Gaussian sigma1 lowpass and transferred at gain1.7 clamped +/-11 only into opaque, low-source-gradient face interiors. All source high-gradient/alpha boundaries remain exact.
